cs.t: I switched to a trio of N95 mini PCs (two from Beelink, one I can't remember but was bought from Geekbuying. These plus some SSD upgrades (from 256->512 GB) and RAM (8->16GB) allows me to have a pretty cheap, very low power  real  "HA" setup. I run Rancher and k3s on it. The N100 is slightly more expensive but also has an even lower TDP. What's nice is that for software that can use an Intel iGPU for hardware video transcoding, these are more than powerful enough to do so and yet draw significantly less power than a full fat GPU. Unless you want to run an LLM or something like Stable Diffusion...
